<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Copilot CLI accepts actual entitled API IDs, while OMP accepts provider-qualified client selectors including base and -1m variants. The registry will model runtime and upstream provider separately, load OMP's effective no-refresh catalog without binding to its SQLite cache, select the matching catalog for CLI output and spawn validation, and fail honestly when OMP inventory is unavailable.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- Expose truthful Copilot CLI and OMP runtime catalogs without confusing API IDs with client selectors.
- Select the target runtime catalog for model and effort validation while preserving warn-don't-block spawning.
- Keep Pi proxy-provider, Claude, and Codex behavior intact.
- Remove committed OMP overrides that collapse base and -1m context variants.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- Refreshing OMP models over the network or binding to its SQLite cache schema.
- Changing installed OMP/Copilot binaries or global user configuration.
- Merging the branch or reconstructing the canonical checkout's local llama-server provider.
